title: Avro Lancaster DV361
memorial_details:
Cairn with rectangular stone fixed to front. Metal inscription plaque fixed to top. Stone bears simple cross carved on front. Lancaster bomber top centre of inscription plaque flanked by RAF Badge on left and Squadron Badge on right. To the left of the memorial stone is a large coloured display board giving full details of the aircraft crash.

The memorial was dedicated on 16-09-98, suggesting a connection to the local community or possibly commemorating the event in a significant way.
inscription: Plaque: IN MEMORY OF/ (Names)/ Who lost their lives when Lancaster DV 361 of 207 Squadron/ crashed nearby on 22nd December 1943/ WE WILL REMEMBER THEM/ Small metal tag below plaque: DEDICATED 16-09-98
